entities.summary: The Mutual Defense Treaty Between the United States and the Republic of the Philippines is an agreement between the two nations recognizing that an attack in the Pacific on either would endanger the peace of both and agreeing to act in concert to meet the common danger. It was signed on August 30, 1951 by their representatives in Washington, D.C. and has eight articles.
